notes: Projection control points in reference_projection.json are synthetic mathematical controls, not survey observations.
The EGM96 fixture currently checks declared CRS metadata only; no geoid grid is sampled and no vertical conversion is computed.
NGA is the primary source for EGM model definitions and published grids. OSGeo PROJ-data is a secondary distribution/format reference and is not substituted for NGA authority.

EGM96 is a legacy model. NGA identifies EGM2008 as its current published Earth Gravitational Model and provides a 2.5-minute worldwide grid; use the model appropriate to the declared target vertical CRS.
The NOAA paper warns that EGM96 geopotential coefficients by themselves do not uniquely determine geoid undulation; model conventions and realization matter.

A numerical known-answer vertical transformation is still not claimed. It requires a grid artifact with recorded version, checksum, license, interpolation rule, and independently sourced point values.
